stages.title: SUBORDINATE ENRICHMENT — ONLY AFTER THE COMPLETE CORE

pills.text: OPTIONAL ADVANCED ENRICHMENT
NEPAL AND BHUTAN ARE HIMALAYAN NEIGHBOURS, BUT THEIR BORDER
NEPAL HAS
AN OPEN-BORDER PLAINS FOOTHILL INTERFACE, WHILE BHUTAN IS A
BANGLADESH IS INDIA'S MOST INTRICATE ALLUVIAL
ENCLAVE HISTORY CASE.
MYANMAR IS THE ONLY LAND NEIGHBOUR THAT PHYSICALLY OPENS
SRI LANKA IS SEPARATED BY A SHALLOW MARITIME GAP

groups.heading: OPTIONAL PROCESS DEPTH
items: Nepal and Bhutan are Himalayan neighbours, but their border character differs: Nepal has
an open-border plains foothill interface, while Bhutan is a steeper mountain-buffer interface.
Bangladesh is India's most intricate alluvial / enclave history case.
Myanmar is the only land neighbour that physically opens India into mainland South-East Asia.

groups.heading: DATA / INSTITUTION LIMIT
items: Sri Lanka is separated by a shallow maritime gap, not by a land border.
LAC = India-China control line; LoC = India-Pakistan military control line in J&K.
NOT: Durand Line is India's boundary with Afghanistan - it is the
Afghanistan-Pakistan line, relevant to India's claimed north-west context, not an India-Pakistan line.

groups.heading: CONTEMPORARY PARALLEL
items: NOT: McMahon Line and LAC are the same everywhere - the McMahon Line relates to the eastern sector's boundary claim
the LAC is the broader present control reality.
NOT: Border guarding forces and legal boundaries are the same subject - the former manage terrain; the latter define sovereignty.
